in_hebrew.name: Rockwell
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rockwell הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'rocc' meaning 'rock' or 'well' meaning 'spring'. The name Rockwell can be interpreted as 'strong spring' or 'rock well'.

in_greek.name: Rockwell
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong, Firm
in_greek.long_meaning: Rockwell είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English 'rocc' meaning 'rock' or 'well' meaning 'spring'. The name Rockwell can be interpreted as 'strong spring' or 'rock well'.

in_latin.name: Rockwell
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong, Firm
in_latin.long_meaning: Rockwell est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English 'rocc' meaning 'rock' or 'well' meaning 'spring'. The name Rockwell can be interpreted as 'strong spring' or 'rock well'.
